title: RunIngestionPipelineForEntityRequest
description: Run the ingestion pipeline of the given type that owns an entity, scoped to that entity alone: a test suite pipeline for a test case, or a profiler, metadata or auto classification pipeline for a table.

entityLink.description: Link to the entity to run the pipeline for, such as `<#E::testCase::{fqn}>` or `<#E::table::{fqn}>`.

pipelineType.description: Type of the pipeline to run for the entity.
